intro.p1Body: Three days above the valley — 21–23 November at Bir–Billing, the paragliding capital of India. Flight, music, food and mountain culture, in one festival.
intro.p2Title: Your whole festival, in one app
intro.p2Body: Buy and carry your pass, register for highlights and experiences, and keep the day's schedule in your pocket.
intro.p3Body: Watch live fly-status from the take-off, breeze through gates even in airplane mode, and reach help fast with SOS. Let's go.

home.flyFlying: Flying today: YES — conditions are good.
home.flyHold: Weather hold: flying is paused. We'll notify you the moment the safety officer clears it.
home.flyClosed: Flying is closed for today — the safety officer's call is final.
home.flyRefundAuto: Affected flight bookings enter the refund queue automatically — nothing to do on your side.
home.feedEmpty: Today's programme arrives soon — check the Schedule tab.
home.sosConfirm: Tap again: call the emergency desk & share your location once
home.sosDone: Emergency desk called. Your location was shared once and will sync if you're offline.
home.heroTitle:
Three days.
One valley.
One app.
home.welcomeSub: बीर में आपका स्वागत है — आज का दिन शानदार है!
home.passOfflineShort: ऑफ़लाइन भी चलेगा — नेटवर्क की ज़रूरत नहीं
home.aboutEn: Bir Festival 2026 is three days of the valley at full brightness — culture on stage every evening, tandem flight in Bir's best flying window, a managed food street of local & SHG kitchens, and bookable experiences hosted by residents. Community-run, one app, 21–23 November.
home.aboutHi: संस्कृति · उड़ान · स्वाद · अनुभव — सब कुछ यहीं, एक ही ऐप में।
home.highlightsSub: मुख्य आकर्षण — शेड्यूल, उड़ान, अनुभव, स्वाद और बहुत कुछ
home.sosStrip: Emergency? One tap alerts the medical grid — posts at Billing, Chogan & Main Venue. मदद बस एक टैप दूर है।
home.missionHi: हर विज़िटर ट्रैवलर · हर निवासी होस्ट · हर परंपरा अनुभव
home.missionEn: A festival by the valley, for the valley — Bir Festival 2026

highlights.title: Highlights

highlights.emptyCategory: Nothing here yet — organisers can add items any time.
highlights.viewOnlyNote: Finale & award ceremony — agenda only, no participation registration.
highlights.consent: I consent to this data being used for festival operations under the DPDP Act. Gender, where asked, is used only for accommodation allocation, is visible only to the hospitality team, and never appears on badges or hotel rosters.

highlights.feeNote: Fee: ₹{{amount}} — payment is confirmed by the provider's webhook, never by this device.

highlights.paidMockBlocked: Payments are disabled in this demo build. Free registrations work end-to-end.
highlights.regFailed: We couldn't save your registration just now — no payment is needed for this event. Please try again.
highlights.formErrors: Please fill the marked fields and consents.
highlights.doneBody: You're in. Find it under My Registrations — gate-checked activities carry a QR pass in your wallet.
highlights.queuedBody: You're offline, so this registration is safely queued and will confirm automatically when the network returns.
highlights.waitlistNote: This activity is full. Join the waitlist and we'll notify you if a place opens — you'll only pay if a spot is confirmed.
highlights.waitlistDoneBody: We'll notify you the moment a place opens. Track it under My Registrations.
highlights.refundPending: Refund of your fee is being processed (T+2).
highlights.myEmpty: No registrations yet — everything in Highlights is one tap away.
